doc: Every flow property set from absent, in a CRLF file (specs/074-desktop-cld-flow-export, contracts/cld-flow-statements.md). Each edit is one splice, and every other byte stays.

steps.doc: The title goes on a line of its own right after the header, an add with the position {after} of an entry of another type (FBL 11.2).

attributes.title: Why it stays out of sight

splices.text: title "Why it stays out of sight"

steps.expect:
causal-loop 1
title "Why it stays out of sight"

variable a "A"
variable b B

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b

steps.doc: The flow statement goes right after the title, its words from the rule's emit.
steps.expect:
causal-loop 1
title "Why it stays out of sight"
flow strength=4

variable a "A"
variable b B

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b

steps.doc: A word the emit places right after a value the statement has is an insert-key.

steps.doc: A variable's word goes after its label: the rule's emit does not place it, so no line is written again.
steps.expect:
causal-loop 1
title "Out of sight"
flow strength=5 delay=6.5 inertia=2 speed=0.5 density=1.5 heatmap=pressure

variable a "A" start=0.7
variable b B

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b

steps.doc: Its second word goes after the first.
steps.expect:
causal-loop 1
title "Out of sight"
flow strength=5 delay=6.5 inertia=2 speed=0.5 density=1.5 heatmap=pressure

variable a "A" start=0.7 push=-1.5
variable b B

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b

causal-loop 1
title "Out of sight"
flow strength=5 delay=6.5 inertia=2 speed=0.5 density=1.5 heatmap=pressure

variable a "A" start=0.7 push=-1.5
variable b B start=0.3

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b

steps.doc: A link's weight is the word it was, written by the rule's emit where the line has no place for it.
steps.expect:
causal-loop 1
title "Out of sight"
flow strength=5 delay=6.5 inertia=2 speed=0.5 density=1.5 heatmap=pressure

variable a "A" start=0.7 push=-1.5
variable b B start=0.3

# Reinforcing.
link a -> b + weight=1.5 "a note"
link b -> a + delayed

loop R1 "Round" a b
